goal: Read-only JACO Windows runtime health verification requested by operator. Use only existing health-check capability to observe Core, Workplace, Nova and current startup/browser-attachment status if exposed by the tool. Return only sanitized READY/DEGRADED/UNVERIFIED states, task receipt identifier and an explicit blocker if the startup receipt cannot be reached; never expose hostnames, paths, credentials, device IDs or logs. No restarts, model downloads, browser navigation, writes, approvals or payments. If the existing Aura-only mode rejects legacy Nova control, report that and do not force it.

contract.objective: Single harmless local JACO readiness observation
acceptance: A real health-check receipt or an explicit rejection/blocker
No file, process, mission-graph, or permission mutations
